M-DSH-PLUGIN.Purpose: Implement the DSH adapter wiring: core runner transport, skill registration, lifecycle handling, and notices.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: DSH typed extension points: tools/post-execute, agent/session-start, session/event, ctx.skills.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Graph, knowledge schema, Resolution, root detection, cache, ontology implementation.

Requirements.REQ-001: `observedReadPath` extracts the canonical path only from accepted, unmodified native `read` results; `observedBashCommand` plus `bashReadFiles` classify accepted, unmodified `bash` results through the bundled `fli-classify-reads` shared classifier, resolving relative paths only against a reliable absolute command cwd: an absolute bash `workdir` argument takes precedence over the session cwd, and with neither, relative classified paths are safely skipped.
Requirements.REQ-002: The core runner invokes bundled `fli ancestors` and returns context, diagnostics/state warnings, and injection status; a classifier failure is an explicit operational diagnostic and never replaces or rejects the original tool result.
Requirements.REQ-003: Notices follow SS-ADAPTER-UX via `createUxMode` and `outputNotices`; `resolveDiagnosticsMode` reads `process.env.FLI_DIAGNOSTICS`.
Requirements.REQ-004: Non-empty newly delivered context is injected via `additionalContexts` with a user-visible injection notice; empty/already-delivered context emits no repetitive success status.

Inputs.IN-001: DSH tool post-execute result for the native `read` tool or the `bash` tool.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Updates bundled Core delivery state through reset operations.
